implementation: Original flat Canvas 2D shapes; no downloaded SVGs, images, bevels or shadows.
texture: Clean gallery artwork uses the page's global grain once. The full-screen viewer's grain covers its artwork and clock. Exported previews contain no grain.
gallery: Shared framed caption band displays each scene's name, series and number.

palette.shade: Darker, muted shades; one hue for all shapes and background at any instant.

posters.title: Stacks
posters.motion: Smooth seeded random arrival and camera clocks; alternating sides; bounded stack surface; top-to-bottom shade order.

posters.title: Blooms
posters.motion: A new bloom every 5.8 seconds, starting at zero radius, expanding exponentially while rotating. Four-, six-, three- and five-lobed shapes alternate every 32 births (185.6 seconds), longer if needed to cover an extreme viewport; each bloom keeps its birth shape.

posters.title: Deep Waves
posters.motion: Concentric, slightly undulating water ripples expand every nine seconds. The scene scrolls slowly vertically and drifts sideways, reversing smoothly without a reset.
posters.palette: Fixed hue 205 degrees, saturation 36 percent; layered shades lighten from the outer deep water toward the inner rings. No full hue cycling.
